# OtakuStream — AI Contributor Guide

Purpose: concise instructions and guardrails for AI assistants and contributors working on OtakuStream.

1) High-level summary

- Flutter reader app with two active sources: WTR (novels) and AsuraScans (manga). The codebase also contains foundations for anime/video playback and additional scraping-backed sources.
- Goal: migrate UI to a source-agnostic architecture where `ContentSource` implementations (WTR, AsuraScans, other APIs) provide data through a `SourceRegistry`.

2) Environment

- Flutter SDK: `>=3.4.0 <4.0.0`
- Entry points: `lib/main.dart`, `lib/src/app.dart`

3) What AI assistants should do (short list)

- Make minimal, focused edits unless user asks for a broader rewrite.
- Prefer adding small, testable units (models, source adapters, services).
- When changing runtime behavior, include a short manual test or a unit/widget test where feasible.
- Always return full file contents for modified files in PRs.

4) Recommended coding rules

- Keep UI widgets free of provider-specific networking or parser logic.
- Put networking, headers, Cloudflare/DNS handling, and scraping in services or source adapters.
- Log network/parsing issues with `Logger`.
- Maintain compatibility with declared Flutter SDK range.

5) Files & areas to inspect first

- `lib/src/core/constants/api_constantsdart` — current API base and paths
- `lib/src/core/network/` — `DioClient` and networking helpers
- `lib/src/features/` — feature modules (home, search, details, reader, extensions, settings)
- `lib/src/features/extensions/` — place new `ContentSource` implementations

Note: the repository currently uses WTR for novel data and AsuraScans for manga. Look for existing AsuraScans-related code under `lib/src/features/reader/`, `lib/src/features/extensions/manga/`, or by grepping for "asura" in the workspace.

6) Suggested incremental work items

- Add model files: `content_item.dart`, `content_details.dart`, `chapter_item.dart` under `lib/src/extensions/models/`.
- Create `content_source.dart` interface and `source_registry.dart` in `lib/src/extensions/registry/`.
- Convert the existing WTR calls into `WtrNovelSource` under `lib/src/extensions/novel/` that implements `ContentSource`.
- Add `PrefsService` for storing selected source ID.

7) Testing & validation

- After changes run `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` when applicable.
- Manual quick checks: `flutter run` on a device/emulator to ensure no regressions in Home/Search flow.

8) Commit / PR guidance for AI-generated changes

- Keep commits focused and include a short description and testing notes.
- If multiple files are edited, group them into a single logical commit that can be reviewed.

9) Constraints / Do-not-do

- Don't replace the entire app unless requested.
- Don't hardcode new external provider credentials or embed secrets.
- Don't mix scraping/Cloudflare hacks directly into UI widgets.

Maintainer: Saksham Shekher / OshekharO

Use this file as the first-read when planning automated or agent-assisted changes.
